findings.reason: Source-file IDs support exposure-response joins, but A56 explicitly states independent replicate IDs NOT_FOUND. Individual versus summary status, replicate counts and original acquisition versus digitization provenance are unspecified. All supplied CENS body values are 0; the note defines CENS=1 but supplies no censoring limit.
findings.needed_material: Confirm the experimental unit, replication and acquisition provenance during independent review. Preserve IDs, dots and CENS values; do not create independent replicates, variability or censoring limits.

findings.reason: A54-A55 establish static nominal concentrations in mg/L. Medium, formulation, chemical dose basis and total versus unbound concentration basis are NOT_FOUND. These concentrations do not establish systemic or infection-site exposure.
findings.needed_material: Retain the in-vitro matrix and nominal basis separately. Obtain source-supported concentration-basis and compatibility information before any conversion or physiological bridge.

findings.reason: A54 supplies a strain-matched MIC and A55 supports nominal exposure-response mapping, but free AUC, an AUC window and time origin, index units, binding assessment and a common comparison-record definition are not supplied. Nominal static concentrations are not measured free AUC.
findings.needed_material: Define the matched analysis window and records, and identify an authorized free-exposure input or planned upstream exposure calculation with its basis and any required binding assessment.

findings.reason: The matched MIC and nominal concentration settings are available, but a free Cmax definition, peak window, time origin, relevant interval, free-exposure support and common comparison-record definition are NOT_FOUND. No measured or model-derived free peak is supplied.
findings.needed_material: Define the peak and comparison window, identify source-supported or planned free-exposure inputs, and preserve whether any later peak is sampled, reported or model-derived.

findings.reason: The KP619 MIC threshold value is available in A54, but nominal static exposure rows do not establish a measured free concentration-time profile. Analysis-window origin, duration versus percentage convention, any percentage denominator and a common response-record mapping remain undefined.
findings.needed_material: Specify free-profile support, matched window and records, threshold context, and duration or percentage convention before downstream fT>MIC calculation.

findings.reason: AVAILABLE_CANDIDATE inputs include organism and strain, nominal static exposure settings, baseline-time observations, bacterial responses, a source-supported ID join, a control exposure and broth-microdilution MIC. Control observations end at TIME 2, while treated IDs have observations through TIME 4, 6 or 8. Time origin, response-reference definition, medium, testing standard, MIC replicates and summary definition, inoculum and independent experimental replication are NOT_FOUND. This static design does not document dosing-frequency or interval variation.
findings.needed_material: Review the source-supported endpoint and comparator definitions, unequal observation windows, susceptibility context and in-vitro conditions. Assess index separability downstream without treating concentration levels as dose-fractionation evidence or importing in-vivo context.

findings.reason: Bacterial counts and baseline-time observations are available, but this page does not define a stasis effect, its reference comparator or its intended endpoint window. No stasis target is reported.
findings.needed_material: Define the stasis endpoint and comparator separately and establish eligible matched exposure-response inputs. Retain target estimation as a later T05 output subject to MI013.

findings.needed_material: Define the 1-log kill endpoint and comparator separately and establish eligible matched exposure-response inputs. Retain target estimation as a later T05 output subject to MI013.
